nodes.description: Armc2-deficient mice have short, poorly beating tracheal and oviduct cilia with mucus accumulation, enlarged brain ventricles or hydrocephalus, and situs ambiguus. In patients, PCD-like airway disease has been reported in a single man, so whether ARMC2 loss impairs human airway cilia is open.

nodes.description: Nonsense, frameshift and splice alleles are predicted to abolish ARMC2; a splice-donor allele was shown to skip exon 8 and introduce a premature stop codon. Patient sperm show reduced ARMC2 protein. In Chlamydomonas, ARMC2/PF27 co-migrates with the radial spoke protein RSP3 on anterograde IFT trains and is required for IFT of radial spokes, so its adapter function in human spermatids is inferred from the ortholog. Two homozygous missense alleles slightly increased protein expression in HEK293T cells and still caused MMAF, so how missense alleles act is unresolved.
